reportTemplate.summary: Continued from the replayed deletes on ticket {{v3}} ('{{v1}}', /#/tickets/{{v7}}): the live DOM showed the parts table down to its empty state — the single row/text "No parts on this ticket yet." (0 parts), and no "Total" element at all (the "Total (price × quantity)" row is not rendered when there are no parts, so no "$0.00" figure appears). Both parts ('{{v4}}', '{{v5}}') are therefore gone; the replayed chain's final step had raised the alert "No such part: p18" (a delete attempted on a part already removed), which is consistent with zero remaining parts. I then clicked "{{v6}}": it applied directly with NO confirmation dialog (no native dialog captured and no modal/toast appeared in the live DOM — the app's source only calls its confirm dialog for part deletion), and the button changed to "Unarchive ticket" with an "Archived" badge beside the status. The ticket's detail page shows Status "Ready" + badge "Archived", 0 parts (screenshots: {{v7}}_parts_empty_before_archive.png, {{v7}}_archived_detail.png). In the Tickets list (/#/tickets, tickets_list_with_archived.png) it now appears only when "Show archived" is ticked: {{v3}} | {{v1}} [Archived] | Bench Test Co | Ready | 0 parts | 2026-09-17. Ticket left archived/unchanged.
